name: Hypera S.A.
summary: Hypera S.A. operates as a pharmaceutical company in Brazil. The company provides sweeteners products under the Adocyl, finn, and Zero-cal brands; analgesics and anti-inflammatories products under the Doril, Atroveran, Calminex, Alivium, Buscopan, Buscofem, geloll, Torsilax, Neosaldina, and naprohax brands; cold and flu remedies and decongestants products under BENEGRIO, Rinosoro, Blu, Neosoro, Coristina, APRACUR, and Fluviral brands.
